title: Meng Xin did not want to sell a sick old ox to others.
text: 3 Meng Xin did not want to sell a sick old ox to others.
Meng Xin: Did you buy my ox?
Meng Xin: Sorry, I can't sell it to you. It's old and sick.
Buyer: It's very kind of you. Thank you.
4 Meng Xin got back his sick old ox. He got a good name too.
What did Meng Xin get from being honest?
